programs.title: Shootout At Lokhandwala
programs.desc: A film based on a real-life gun battle between the Mumbai police and gangsters in Mumbai Lokhandwala Complex in 1991. The movie follows the story of a notorious gangster, and his team who terrorize the city with their crimes. As the police close in on them, a bloody shootout ensues, leaving many dead on both sides. The film explores the complex dynamics between law enforcement and organized crime in Mumbai's underworld.

programs.title: Madhoshi
programs.desc: Despite being engaged to Arpit, Anupama falls in love with Aman, a stranger. However, when her family members decide to meet him, they are shocked to discover that a person named Aman does not exist.

programs.title: Hello Hum Lallan Bol Rahe Hain
programs.desc: Lallan, a security guard, loves Saroja, who is supposed to get married to an older man for money. However, while convincing her to change her mind, he finds out another shocking fact about her.
